lines.speaker: ilse
lines.text: Then we starve honestly. Miss Vance, take your case back down the mountain.

lines.speaker: vance
lines.text: You will regret this inside the year. I say that without pleasure; everyone does, and I have made this offer eleven times.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: That is the charter I grew up under. Word for word, the doorpost version, the one we read out every winter.

lines.speaker: wren
lines.text: I always assumed it was written by somebody braver than me. It was written by a woman who dug a well and had nothing else, and I do not know yet whether that is better.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vance closes her case without hurrying. Behind her, on the transport, something tall unfolds itself in sections and starts up the path.
